build_constraints_check_values: build a python script that uses torch.distributions.constraints to check if tensor values satisfy given constraints
create_independent_constraint: create an independent constraint that reinterprets batch dimensions as event dimensions for multivariate checks
test_simplex_constraint: test the simplex constraint that validates nonnegative vectors summing to one
test_lower_cholesky_constraint: test the lower_cholesky constraint that validates lower-triangular matrices with positive diagonals
review_cat_constraint: review the cat constraint that applies a sequence of constraints across concatenated submatrices
